scope: PROPOSED observer-only phase; no live commands executed or approved
prerequisite_state: All false means NOT ESTABLISHED, not an assertion about current hardware state.
abort_on_first: SCSI timeout, I/O error or filesystem activity
unexpected tty/block client or host probe
uncertain board identity or unapproved transaction
abort_action: Stop observations, save host-side evidence, return for review. No automatic reset, unplug, mode change or recovery.
